The '''Evolutionary Warfare Laboratory''' was a [[Laboratory/Legends|section]] of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation's]] [[CI-004 Research Facility]] on [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. It was used to experiment upon [[Species/Legends|specimens]].<ref name="TOR" />
